headline: Public hearings on rezoning 87 High Street to Mixed-Use Commercial and a seven-unit residential building at 57 St. Lawrence Street.
summary: The meeting also includes a report on the approved site plan for 105 Winter Street, with three waivers. Project files for both hearings are on the city's CSS Portal under plan numbers ZN-003710-2026 and PL-003711-2026.
items: Report on the November 10, 2026 approval of the major site plan at 105 Winter Street, with three waivers
Public hearing on rezoning 87 High Street from Residential Neighborhood-4 (RN-4) to Mixed-Use Commercial (B-3)
Public hearing on a major site plan to split the lot at 57 St. Lawrence Street and build a four-story, seven-unit residential building with seven covered parking spaces

PUBLIC COMMENT INFORMATION: 
To submit written public comment on an agenda item, email planningboard@portlandmaine.gov. Submissions 
must be received by 12:00 pm the day before the Planning Board meeting to guarantee their inclusion in the 
agenda packet. All submissions must include the commenter's name and legal address. To help ensure your 
comment is submitted for the correct item, please include the name of the agenda item (see below). 
 
 
AGENDA: 
 
    
PUBLIC HEARING - 4:30 PM 
    
1. ROLL CALL AND DECLARATION OF QUORUM 
2. COMMUNICATION AND REPORTS 
3. REPORT OF ATTENDANCE AT THE MEETING HELD ON NOVEMBER 10, 2026 
  Public Workshop: 
92 Cassidy Point Drive: Joe Zamboni, Nicholas Messina, Kelsey Robertson, Austin Smith, Beverly 
Uhlenhake, David Silk, and Eric Din.  
 
Public Hearing: 
105 Winter Street: Joe Zamboni, Nicholas Messina, Kelsey Robertson, Austin Smith, Beverly 
Uhlenhake, David Silk, and Eric Din. 
4. REPORTS OF DECISIONS AT THE MEETING HELD ON NOVEMBER 10, 2026 
  i. Major Site Plan; 105 Winter Street; 105 Winter LLC, Applicant. Robertson motioned, and Silk 
seconded a motion to waive Technical Manual Standard 1.5.1.C, which requires that local 
streets have driveway spacing of 50 feet, to allow the applicant to have driveway spacing of 
23.43 feet and 36.92 feet from the nearest abutting driveways. Vote 7-0. Robertson motioned, 
and Silk seconded a motion to waive Technical Manual Standard, Figure I-11A, which requires 
a curb reveal of seven inches, to allow the applicant to have a curb reveal of five inches.  Vote 
7-0. Robertson motioned, and Silk seconded a motion to waive Technical Manual Standard 
1.5.1.A, which requires only one driveway, to allow the applicant to construct two driveways. 
Vote 7-0. Robertson motioned, and Silk seconded a motion to approve the major site Plan 
application. Vote 7-0. Robertson motioned, and Silk seconded a motion to adopt the findings 
contained in the November 10, 2026 staff report and draft approval letter, and to authorize the 
Board Chair to sign the approval letter as drafted. Vote 7-0. 
5. NEW BUSINESS 
  i. Zoning Map Amendment; 87 High Street; Ramsey Lafayette, Applicant.  The Planning Board 
will hold a public hearing to consider a map amendment application to rezone the parcel at 87 
High Street from Residential Neighborhood-4 (RN-4) to Mixed-Use Commercial (B-
3).  Project information and documents are available for viewing on the city's CSS Portal 
(https://css.portlandmaine.gov/) by referencing Plan Number ZN-003710-2026. 
  ii. Major Site Plan; 57 St. Lawrence Street; Fafnir St. Lawrence, LLC., Applicant.  The Planning 
Board will hold a public hearing to consider a Major Site Plan application to split the lot at 57 
St. Lawrence Street to facilitate the construction of a four-story, seven-unit multi-family 
residential building with seven covered parking spaces.  The subject property is located in the 
RN-4 zone and the Munjoy Hill Historic District.  Project information and documents are 
available for viewing on the city's CSS Portal (https://css.portlandmaine.gov/) by referencing 
Plan Number PL-003711-2026.
